errors.text: The proposed alloy and route do not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo ball-milled powder and 1000 °C spark-plasma-sintering system.
The stated processing window is internally inconsistent: 1200 K is about 927 °C, whereas 1230 °C is about 1503 K, so HIP at 1230 °C cannot simultaneously remain below a 1200 K disordering threshold.
A disordering threshold inferred from a molecular-dynamics friction simulation of FeNiCrCoCu is transferred without justification to chemically distinct AlCoCrFeNi and TaNbHfZrTi bulk alloys.
The cited TaNbHfZrTi HIP evidence supports BCC-to-BCC+HCP evolution, not the claimed formation of nanoscale L21 precipitates.
No aqueous-corrosion experiment in 3.5 wt% NaCl is proposed, and the predicted corrosion resistance lacks direct supporting evidence.
The proposed refractory TaNbHfZrTi option is incompatible with the lightweight-alloy objective.
